answer: Score continuity, not just moments: each identity keeps a rolling fingerprint of style, timing and counterparties across epochs, and graders sample that history before attesting. A farm that rotates one writer across many accounts leaves the same thread of habits in every cloth, and an account sold to a new owner breaks its own weave; both lose their haven of earned standing. Cloning multiplies the history you must keep consistent, not the nectar you can sip.
